title: Go 1.23+ Idiomatic Backend
summary: Go 1.23+, Standard Layout, Chi / sqlc, structured concurrency, table tests
rules: Always check errors immediately and wrap with %w: if err != nil { return fmt.Errorf('...: %w', err) }.
Project structure: cmd/server/ for entrypoint; internal/ for private application packages; avoid pkg/ unless public.
First argument of any I/O or network function must be ctx context.Context.
Prevent goroutine leaks: all goroutines must have explicit exit triggers (context cancellation, channel close, errgroup).
Write table-driven tests. Use _test black-box packages for integration testing.
